key_features: LICENSED MASTERCHEF PRODUCT - This professional quality handheld stainless steel stick blender set is a licensed product of MasterChef the TV Series.

3 IN 1: BLEND, WHISK, FROTH - 3 In 1 stick blender with attachments for blending, whisking, and frothing. The perfect combination of blending tools for a wide variety of fast and fine food processing results.

STAINLESS STEEL - All three attachments are made of professional grade, stainless-steel. The durable strong blender blades can handle soft and hard ingredients to make deliciously healthy smoothies and shakes, blend hearty soups, puree baby foods and more.
VARIABLE SPEEDS - With variable speed controls to adjust to different foods and purposes easily. Simply turn the speed up or down to perfect the texture of all your food blends and baking mixes.
DETACHABLE - The interchangeable blending, whisking and frothing attachments are easily detachable for efficient cleaning and compact storage.

EASY TO CLEAN - The detachable blending, whisking and frothing parts are easy to clean with warm soapy water and are dishwasher safe. The electronic part of the stick blender should not be washed in water but can be wiped with a damp cloth.
